description: SIMULATED phyphox gyroscope export: phone on a string, pivot to phone centre 0.75 m, released from 35 deg, swinging in the plane of the screen. Replace with your own recording.
model: theta'' = -(g/L_eq) sin(theta) - 2 zeta_lin wn theta' - c_quad |theta'| theta';  L_eq = d + (h^2 + w^2)/(12 d) (phone as an h x w plate swinging in its own plane)
nonidealities: gyro bias (-5, 1.5, -2.5) mrad/s, white noise 1.5 mrad/s rms, 16-bit quantization (1.06 mrad/s), 4 deg axis misalignment, string twist mode 0.55 Hz, hand tremor before release, time-stamp jitter 0.15 ms rms
